title: What generative AI does
summary: Generative AI predicts and constructs outputs from patterns in data; it does not independently know whether a clinical claim is true.
takeaway: Treat fluency as presentation quality, not proof.

title: Hallucination and citation fabrication
summary: Models can invent plausible facts, guidelines and references.
takeaway: Open and verify every critical source.

title: Automation bias
summary: People may over-trust computer-generated recommendations, especially when they are well formatted.
takeaway: Require an explicit human reviewer and a challenge step.

title: Privacy and data leakage
summary: Sensitive text may be retained or processed outside approved systems depending on the provider and organisational configuration.
takeaway: Use de-identified fictional data unless the system is explicitly approved.

title: Prompt injection
summary: Uploaded or retrieved content may contain instructions that manipulate an AI workflow.
takeaway: Treat external content as data, not trusted instructions.

title: Bias and equity
summary: Outputs may underrepresent populations or reproduce stereotypes and historical inequities.
takeaway: Check subgroup applicability, missing populations and language.
